content:
Hey, I honestly don't even know why you're so upset right now. I mean, are you sure you didn't just *imagine* something happened? I feel like you've been really insecure lately, and sometimes you just make things up in your head. You know you can be kind of jealous, right? Besides, we've been arguing a lot, maybe that's why you're feeling this way. I didn’t cheat on you, I don’t know where you’re getting all this from. Maybe you should trust me more if you want this to work. 

Are you sure you didn't just misinterpret something? Because nothing happened. If you keep questioning me about things that don’t exist, I honestly don’t know what you expect from me.
